theorems.name: Submission.poincare_ball_convex_combination_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable h → ∀ r t : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, h ((1 - t) • y + t • x) ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * volume (ball (0 : Rn n) r) * ∫⁻ z in ball (0 : Rn n) r, h z
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
